description.p: VPNdeck is a simple desktop client for OpenVPN. Import the .ovpn profile from your OpenVPN server and connect with one click.

ul.li: Big, clear connection status with VPN address, server and traffic
System tray icon for quick connect and disconnect
Optional saved password in your desktop keyring for automatic sign-in
Connection log in its own window
Updates itself from inside the app

description.p: Needs OpenVPN 2.4 or newer installed on the system (sudo apt install openvpn).
Adds an .rpm package for Fedora and openSUSE. File dialogs no longer freeze the window, removing a profile asks for confirmation, and buttons and links work from the keyboard and with screen readers.
States the supported OpenVPN version (2.4 or newer) and drops gateway-specific wording.
